Render 03 — PROPOSED: Ads station. The ad copy and campaign data already exist in the repo (Northstar_backend/ad_pilot.py, importers/ads_api_importer.py → keyword_performance with searchTerm / impressions / clicks / spend / orders / sales). What is NEW: binding each creative variant to the search term it targets, the listing-to-ad consistency check, and the experiment slot.
